_comment: Error values as the Tauri runtime delivers them to the webview: bare strings, not Error objects. Unit mocks reject with these so a handler that reads err.message is caught. The first two come from the fs plugin and the ACL; the rest are the shape of a Rust command returning Err(String).
forbiddenPath: forbidden path: /Users/someone/.zshrc, maybe it is not allowed on the scope for `allow-exists` permission in your capability configuration file
aclDenied: fs.write_text_file not allowed. Permissions associated with this command: fs:allow-write-file, fs:default, fs:write-all
commandNotAllowed: Command guarded_write_file not allowed by ACL
rustRefusal: refused: the file changed on disk since it was read (expected sha256 does not match)
ioError: No such file or directory (os error 2)
